events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We've reviewed your cancellation fee dispute and you're getting a full refund of $6.61, paid as a Ryde voucher.

What decided it: your driver cancelled the trip, and the trip record shows he was only inside the pickup area for about 1 minute 40 seconds before cancelling — less than the more than 3 minutes required for the fee to stand.

Nothing else changes: there's no mark on your account, and you can keep booking as usual. Ryde keeps final discretion over these refunds.

DRIVER: We've reviewed the cancellation on this trip and the $6.61 fee has been voided — it won't be charged to the rider and won't count against you.

What decided it: you tapped "I'm Here" while inside the pickup radius, but the record shows you cancelled about 1 minute 40 seconds after arriving at the pickup point. That's less than the more than 3 minutes required to charge a cancellation fee.

No action is needed from you and there's no flag on your account. Please allow the full wait period before cancelling in future. Ryde keeps final discretion over these decisions.
